summary: The first-variation and dual moment characterization are correct; the crossing-count propagation exhausts all centered fan-transverse cases and yields exactly the two stated rank-five configurations. The constraint differentials are regular, the KKT localization correctly excludes full rank and the three-crossing-edge family, and the rank-five A,C,E triangle algebra together with the cap inequalities forces a contradiction when p1,p2 are at most one half. The remaining B,D,F triangle has precisely the claimed crossing and product conditions. The off-center rectangle has the stated ratios and is globally minimizing on the p1=p2=0 feasible class.
